content.title: ESC Committee for Practice Guidelines 2018-2020 - Declarations of Interest
content.note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year.

experts.name: Juni Peter
financial_declaration: Payment from healthcare industry to department/institution for personal services: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member.
Amgen Inc: PCSK9 inhibitors in Patients at Cardiovascular Risk.
other_positions_of_influence: Employment in healthcare industry (including part time) during the year: Director, Applied Health Research Centre, St. Michael's Hospital.
Unpaid member of steering group of trials funded by Abbott Vascular, AstraZeneca, Biotronik, Biosensors, St. Jude Medical, Terumo and The Medicines Company.
Research grants to institution from AstraZeneca, Biotronik, Biosensors International, Eli Lilly and The Medicines Company.
Honoraria to the institution for participation in advisory boards and/or consulting from Amgen, Ava and Fresenius.
Has not received personal payments by any pharmaceutical company or device manufacturer.
